description: For relatives: pledge a part of the price of a wish, so several people can give it together. Only for wishes with a price that nobody reserved, up to what is still missing (see target_amount and collected_amount in get_wishlist). Nothing is paid here. Returns contribution_id and contribution_token; keep both to undo with withdraw_contribution. Needs the share link.

amount.description: Amount in the currency of the price, e.g. 20 or 12.50.

name.description: Optional name of who chips in, e.g. "Oma Rosi". Shown to parents and family, the amount only to the parents.

share_link.description: The share link (https://wunschzettel.mapumi.de/z/…) or just its id.

name: contribute_to_wish
title: Chip in for a wish
